explorer.saveViewHint: Saves nesting, sorting and layout so you find it again in the sidebar.
explorer.emptyHint: Scan the barcode on a case or search for a title.
explorer.noResultsHint: Search looks at title, platform, publisher, developer, genre, place, people, notes and barcodes.
explorer.deleteViewHint: “{name}” will be deleted. Games and other views stay unchanged.
explorer.lastView: The last view can't be deleted.
explorer.nestingHint: Folder levels from top to bottom; drag or use Alt+arrow keys to reorder.
explorer.filtersHint: Only show copies that match – e.g. kind is game, title matches A*, box has a value. Patterns: * for any text, ? for one character; without * it means "contains".
explorer.fieldsHint: Each presentation has its own fields. They're saved with the view.

presentationHints.grid: The grey line under each card's title.
presentationHints.list: The grey line under each row's title.
presentationHints.detail: Game fields go to the game block, release fields to the release block, copy fields onto each copy card.

explorer.sortHint: Up to five levels, any field – shown or not. Ties go to the next level, finally the title. Saved with the view.
explorer.sortDefault: By title (default). Pick a field on the left to sort by it.
explorer.sectionsHint: Splits the list into sections with collapsible headings, e.g. by platform or date added. Unlike nesting, everything stays on one page.

column.releases: The game’s release | All {n} releases of the game
